surface.glyphs: Shared FreeType LCD glyphs. Calendar uses hinted single advances with design-pair rounding; recorded numeric 11 spacing and native link caps.
surface.scope: Other dates/cultures/fonts/display profiles and property combinations remain open. Explicit character widths calibrated at 20/35/60 only; HeightInMonths=0 observations retain one row.

nativeMetricsChangedAfterFreeze: Explanatory scope/acceptance metadata only; all XML, rows, dimensions and RGB hashes are unchanged.

implementation.dimensions: Month counts precede Width/Height. Default338x300; 2x1=649x300, 1x2=338x547, 2x2=649x547. Font12=380x336, bold16=443x390. ShowCurrentDate=false removes36px at normal10pt. Side month panel adds113px and replaces the long-date footer.
implementation.characterMode: WidthInMonths=0 is measured at Width20/35/60:202/352/602px with centered content and native clipping. Three HeightInMonths=0 sources retain one300px row, including requested Height20; this observation is not generalized to arbitrary height/stretch modes.
implementation.monthPaint: Grid #dedede; normal cell42x30, font12 cell48x34, bold16 cell57x40; eight rows and seven columns per month, seven-pixel month gaps. Interior adjacent-month duplicate dates are omitted.
implementation.selection: The current-date outline is two pixels green, then a white inset and dark fill. ShowCurrentDate=false retains the dark selected day but removes the green outline and footer. ReadOnly and disabled surfaces share lighter recorded paint and #e8e8e8 outer border.
implementation.text: Existing shared FreeType LCD raster/faces. Hinted single advances and rounded design-pair advances; numeric 11 spacing is independently recorded for each accepted font profile. Header/weekday/body/link palettes and baseline/centering rules differ. Native link dashes/end caps and the 12pt Cyrillic Today-label advance are recorded. Other dates/languages/fonts need their own comparison.
implementation.locales: Calendar dates/months use en-US regional settings, while Today/Сегодня follows the UI language. The viewer keeps culture separate from translated UI strings. Other regional settings currently use browser fallback and the existing localized approximation notice.
implementation.sourceSemantics: BackColor is removed by native export; false ShowMonthsPanel, true ShowCurrentDate and Height9 are omitted defaults. Original requests and canonical exports are preserved separately. No BSL runs.
implementation.icons: 210 opaque grayscale samples describe only the two tiny arrow states and dropdown corner, not text or a whole-widget bitmap.
implementation.lifecycle: Solid component preserves outer DOM identity and redraws on XML/model updates, resize, zoom and local midnight. One webview reuses the existing lazy font runtime/faces.
implementation.testClock: Only owned test webviews receive a Date proxy matching the native reference date; normal timers and requestAnimationFrame remain real. A valid temporary XML comment triggers repaint through the real dirty-document path. Each fresh detached/reattached frame repeats the setup. Production has no reference date or test-clock flag.
implementation.scopeGate: Linux/DPR1/zoom100, three recorded font profiles, en-US region and recorded month-count/character-width profiles. Raster limits4096 per axis and4194304 outer pixels. Fallback and localized notice remain for uncalibrated conditions.
